SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ CASE WHEN t.PS in('T01','T02') THEN t.PRIN_AMT ELSE t.TRADE_AMT END AS tradeAmt,/**成交金额**/ t.SHARE_AMT dealNum,/**交易份额**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ t.TRADE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO trdMyAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE in( '06','07') LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) where t.BUSI_TYPE IN('06','07') and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17' AND t.PS IN('T01','T02','T04','T05','T18','T19','T24','T52')
and t.TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
and NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) IN
#{finprodId}
and zc.FINPROD_ID IN
#{assetId}
and t.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND t.PS IN
#{ps}
order by t.TRADE_ID desc

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ t.TRADE_DATE redConfirmDate,/**确认日期**/ t.TRADE_AMT redConfirmAmt,/**确认金额**/ t.SHARE_AMT redConfirmNum,/**确认数量**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE redUnitValue,/**单位净值**/ t.FEE_AMT_UNPAY redFee,/**赎回费**/ null arriveDate,/**到账日期**/ null tradeAmtArrive,/**到账金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO redMyAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE in( '06','07') LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) where t.BUSI_TYPE in ('06','07') and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1
select count(1) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
